platform.headline: How STREN unites coaching intention and athlete execution.
platform.description: Traditional coaching relies on detached PDFs, scattered chats, and forgotten notebooks. STREN creates a continuous, two-way pipeline where every workout prescription flows seamlessly into a live guided workout and returns verified performance telemetry to the coach.

coachBlock.title: The Coach Command Center
coachBlock.description: Coaches design structured workout templates with target weights, target RPE, and rest timers, then assign them directly to athlete rosters.

memberBlock.title: The Member Active Session
memberBlock.description: Members launch today's scheduled workout, view previous lift benchmarks, check off completed sets, swap occupied equipment, and submit perceived exertion.

feedbackBanner.text: Session tonnage (kg), completion rate, and logged RPE automatically sync back to the Coach Dashboard upon completion.

targets.title: Prescription Targets & RPE
targets.description: Coaches do not just name movements—they specify exact target weights and target RPE thresholds. Athletes know the exact intensity intended for every single set.

memory.title: Previous Performance Memory
memory.description: During active training, STREN surfaces the member's last verified weight and reps directly in the input row. Progressive overload is structured, not remembered.

telemetry.title: Instant Tonnage & Telemetry
telemetry.description: No manual spreadsheets or check-in text messages. Completed sessions instantly calculate total volume, log session duration, and update adherence stats for coach review.

coaches.headline: Precision programming and active roster oversight.

members.headline: A guided workout partner that remembers every rep.
members.description: STREN turns prescribed workouts into an interactive live session tracker with previous lift benchmarks, in-session exercise swapping, and instant volume calculation.

step1.title: Assigned Workout Access
step1.description: Open your active assignments anytime. View prescribed exercise order, target reps, target weights, and coach instructions.

step2.title: Guided Live Session Launch
step2.description: Launch today's workout in distraction-free session mode. Navigate exercise blocks with real-time rest timers and target guidance.

step3.title: Previous Performance Memory
step3.description: Never guess what you lifted last week. STREN automatically surfaces previous weight and rep benchmarks directly in your set row.

step4.title: In-Session Exercise Swapping
step4.description: Gym equipment taken or feeling joint pain? Swap to a compatible movement on the fly with a reason logged for your coach.

step5.title: RPE Exertion & Summary
step5.description: Finish your workout, log your subjective session RPE (1–10), and view total volume tonnage automatically saved to your profile.

howItWorks.headline: From prescription to reflection in six clear stages.
howItWorks.description: See how STREN coordinates programming, delivery, live execution, and telemetry between coaches and athletes with zero manual data transfer.

stage1.title: Prescription & Template Creation
stage1.description: Coach selects compound movements, establishes exercise sequencing, and prescribes target weights, target RPE ratings, and rest intervals in the Workout Builder.

stage2.title: Athlete Assignment
stage2.description: Coach assigns the structured workout routine to an active member or group with scheduled training dates, making the routine immediately available.

stage3.title: Instant Notification Alert
stage3.description: Real-time Socket.IO notification delivers instant alert to the athlete's workspace, prompting them with today's scheduled training program.

stage4.title: Live Guided Execution
stage4.description: Member starts the workout. STREN displays previous session performance benchmarks, runs rest countdown timers, and allows on-the-fly exercise swaps.

stage5.title: RPE Exertion & Session Finish
stage5.description: Upon finishing all working sets, the member logs subjective session RPE (1–10) and notes, completing the workout and compiling total volume tonnage.

stage6.title: Performance Review & Feedback
stage6.description: Completed session stats, volume logs, and RPE ratings instantly update on the Coach Dashboard for progress verification and program progression.

features.headline: Engineered for serious strength training.
features.description: Every module in STREN was built to solve authentic coaching and athletic execution challenges—with concrete target prescriptions, previous performance memory, and live telemetry.

bento1.title: Target Weight & RPE Prescription
bento1.description: Coaches do not merely list exercises—they define exact prescribed loads (kg), target RPE intensity ratings (1–10), and strict rest periods for every exercise in the template.

bento2.title: In-Session Exercise Swapping
bento2.description: Equipment taken or experiencing joint pain? Members can swap to an alternative exercise on the fly, with reason logging preserved for the coach.
bento2.coachNote: Logged to Coach: "Bench press was occupied by 3 lifters; swapped to dumbbells."

bento3.title: Previous Performance Memory
bento3.description: During active training, STREN surfaces what you performed in the previous session so you never wonder what weights to rack.

bento4.title: Body Measurements & Physical Progress
bento4.description: Log body weight, estimated body fat percentage, and anatomical circumferences (chest, waist, hips, arms, thighs). Correlate physical adaptations with training volume.
bento4.footer: Full historical log with delta tracking

card1.title: Categorized Exercise Taxonomy
card1.description: Filter hundreds of compound and isolation movements by target muscles and equipment in our exercise database.

card2.title: Real-Time Socket.IO Alerts
card2.description: Instant alerts notify athletes of new assignments and alert coaches when a member completes a training session.

card3.title: Total Volume & Tonnage Logs
card3.description: Every verified repetition compiles automatically into total lifted kg, surfacing true training density and progressive overload.
